extracted.name: Easy Meatball Casserole
extracted.description: Frozen meatballs are an easy shortcut in this quick casserole made with tomato soup and instant rice.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix meatballs, asparagus, chicken broth, tomato soup, instant rice, and Italian seasoning in a large bowl. Pour into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until rice is tender, about 30 minutes.
